parsed.rationale_overall: System B provides more specific quantitative personalization (calculating annual savings, projected FIRE trajectory, and glide-path timing tied to the user's age and 15-year horizon) and offers more concrete actionable steps including specific dollar amounts, HSA contributions, and tax-loss harvesting mechanics. System B also demonstrates stronger diversification reasoning with international exposure (VXUS) and more grounded factual claims, while System A includes some questionable figures (e.g., 18.5% CAGR requirement, -78% Nasdaq claim) and less precise personalization.
